title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

reports.title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

summary:
A person in the Ards and north Down area lost £250,000 in an AI generated investment scam, according to the Police Service of Northern Ireland. The victim saw an AI video that appeared to feature a well known financial sector personality and promoted an investment with claimed significant returns. After a small initial investment, the victim was contacted on WhatsApp and urged to pay more. The PSNI did not name the celebrity, though BBC News NI has seen similar scams using financial experts such as Martin Lewis, Peter Jones and Steven Bartlett.

Police said the fraud was sophisticated. The criminals persuaded the victim to open multiple online accounts and gave them remote access to their computer, saying they were helping with the investment. The victim was encouraged to borrow money, and funds went to accounts controlled by criminals. Superintendent Joanne Gibson of the Scamwise Partnership urged people to stop and check financial activity and to talk with relatives about fraud. Police advised independently verifying who they are dealing with and checking that financial services providers are authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority.
